toc.title: Themes
toc.content: See the map themes here. Open it to manage the list.

tocPanel.title: Manage themes
tocPanel.content: Turn each theme on or off, change the order, and adjust the transparency.

themesAdd.title: Add themes
themesAdd.content: Bring new themes into the map.

themesAddPanel.title: Load a theme
themesAddPanel.content: Load themes from WMS, WMTS or WFS services, or from files on your computer.

measure.title: Measure
measure.content: Measure distances and areas on the map.

measurePanel.title: Measure on the map
measurePanel.content: Mark points on the map and read the distance or area in real time.

draw.title: Draw
draw.content: Draw and annotate on the map.

drawPanel.title: Draw on the map
drawPanel.content: Draw points, lines, polygons and text. Export the drawing as GeoJSON.

identify.title: Identify
identify.content: Get the information behind a point on the map.

identifyPanel.title: Identify features
identifyPanel.content: Click a point on the map to see the features visible at that spot.

coordinatesPanel.title: Go to a coordinate
coordinatesPanel.content: Enter coordinates to go to a point, or click the map to read the coordinates of a location.

geolocation.title: My location
geolocation.content: Find your own position on the map.

geolocationPanel.title: Your position
geolocationPanel.content: After you allow it, the map goes to your current position. Useful in the field on a phone.

print.title: Print
print.content: Produce a PDF of the map.

printPanel.title: Print a map
printPanel.content: Choose the scale and the sheet format, then generate the PDF layout.

search.title: Search
search.content: Type the name of a place. Pick a suggestion to go there on the map.

share.title: Share map
share.content: Create a link to the current map view. Send the link to share the location.

save.title: Save viewer
save.content: Save the current view and themes as your own viewer. You can return to it later.

locale.title: Language
locale.content: Change the language of the viewer interface.

login.title: Login
login.content: Log in to your account to reach the restricted features.

help.title: Help
help.content: Open the viewer manual. It describes each tool.

scale.title: Map scale
scale.content: See the current scale. Type a value like 1:25000 to jump straight to that scale.

crs.title: Coordinates
crs.content: See the cursor coordinates. Change the reference system in the selector.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: Send a message to the responsible service. You can attach files.

basemaps.title: Base maps
basemaps.content: Change the map background. Choose between street map, satellite or orthophotos.

mapControls.title: Navigation
mapControls.content: Zoom the map in and out. Use the full extent button to return to the complete view.
